top_strength: Arden gathered comprehensive logistics details (property type, floor, parking, walking distance, special items, box count) and delivered clear, transparent pricing with full fee disclosure and both Two Promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries coverage) fully explained.
coaching_note: Section 2's Their Agenda was asked too late (after logistics probing had begun) and when the customer raised a price concern, Arden never followed up with 'tell me more' to understand what made her anxious about cost—that missed layer cost the entire follow-up thread, and the call ended without ever asking for the business or confirming if a future date works.
